title: The night line
description: A mechanical destination board turns a practical selection into a small moment of departure.
useCase: Give travel, event schedules or destination choices a tactile identity while keeping the selected information readable.
reducedMotion: The destination updates immediately without rotation. Keyboard selections are also immediate.
limitations: A stylized single hinged tile turn, not an alphabet-by-alphabet physical simulation. Departure times and distances are fictional demonstration content.
look: Dark navy board with six slate letter tiles split by a black seam, cream heavy capitals, orange accent square and active button, and monospace labels.
motion: Choosing a destination turns each letter tile over on its horizontal axis from the old letter to the new, 440 ms with ease-in-out, staggered 45 ms left to right.
adapt: Each `sf-departures-leaf` carries the previous and next letter on `sf-departures-front`/`sf-departures-back` and runs `sf-departures-turn` (440 ms) with a per-cell `animationDelay`; remounting on `selection.sequence` replays it. Replace `services`; the grid assumes six-letter names.
